text:
Priya: Quick sync — need a decision on GA scope split. Sales has two asks: (1) ship Hosted + Dedicated together with tiered SLA and 24/7 oncall at GA, or (2) host GA first, Dedicated + 24/7 ramp later. Need alignment before shiproom.
Dan: Leaning toward option (2) — lower risk, faster time-to-GA.
Eli: +1 for (2). Also we must define minimal monitoring for GA so we don't ship blind.
Maya: If we do (2), we need clear comms: 'Dedicated coming soon' and an enterprise FAQ so customers know timing and what to expect.
Priya: Proposed minimal GA commitments to present tomorrow: 
```
GA minimum deliverables:
- Hosted API: production-readiness for public models, documented rate limits and quotas
- SLA: published expectations (best-effort for hosted) + explicit disclaimer on Dedicated SLA timeline
- Monitoring: request tracing, per-model latency dashboards, error budget alerts (per-route)
- Support: business-hours support + prioritization rubric; enterprise handoff for Dedicated customers
- Docs: Quickstart, Admin guide, Enterprise FAQ, and SLA explainer
- Pricing: published hosted list price, Dedicated pricing flagged as 'contact sales' / early-access
```
Dan: Can we set an initial SLO for hosted: p95 latency < 250ms and error rate < 0.5%?
Eli: p95 250ms is optimistic for larger models. We should define SLOs by model class (small/medium/large) and include a fallback policy that routes heavy requests to dedicated variants when available.
Maya: Also add an ops playbook: steps for investigation, escalation path, and customer communication template.
Priya: Assign owners: Docs -> Maya, Monitoring -> Eli, SLA legal wording -> Dan, SRE signoff for Dedicated SLA -> ops-bot.
ops-bot: Note: current oncall capacity does not allow committing to 24/7 Dedicated support before 2025-01-15.
Priya: OK — consensus: ship Hosted GA with limited published expectations; mark Dedicated SLA & 24/7 oncall as post-GA milestones. I'll prepare a one-pager for shiproom capturing the decision and the owner checklist.
Dan: Sounds good. :thumbsup:
Eli: I'll start drafting the dashboards and include model-class SLO buckets.
Maya: I'll draft the FAQ and ops playbook, will ping for review.
Priya: Thanks everyone — I'll update the launch board and schedule the exec readout for 09:30 tomorrow.
